options.content: The store table at the bottom is sortable; its "needs attention" column feeds the field agents' follow-up list. Reliability thresholds come from `platform_settings` (`shop_expiry_penalty_threshold_bp`, `store_strike_risk_threshold`). Runbook: `docs/runbooks/risk-store-strikes.md`.

panels.title: Store funnel (businesses created in range)
panels.description: Businesses created in range and how far they got. Active in week 4 is the store cohort grid on 09.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (SELECT b.* FROM businesses b WHERE $__timeFilter(b.created_at)),
st AS (SELECT s.id, s.business_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM store_items i WHERE i.store_id = s.id AND i.is_listed) AS items,
              (SELECT min(placed_at) FROM orders o WHERE o.store_id = s.id) AS first_order FROM stores s WHERE s.business_id IN (SELECT id FROM b) AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}'))
SELECT 'Created' AS step, 1 AS n, count(*) AS businesses FROM b
UNION ALL SELECT 'Submitted', 2, count(*) FROM b WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'Verified', 3, count(*) FROM b WHERE verified_at IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'First product', 4, count(DISTINCT business_id) FROM st WHERE items >= 1
UNION ALL SELECT '50 products', 5, count(DISTINCT business_id) FROM st WHERE items >= 50
UNION ALL SELECT 'First order', 6, count(DISTINCT business_id) FROM st WHERE first_order IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY n

SELECT 'created → submitted' AS step, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM submitted_at - created_at) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS median_h
FROM businesses WHERE submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
UNION ALL SELECT 'submitted → verified', round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM verified_at - submitted_at) / 3600)::numeric, 1)
FROM businesses WHERE verified_at IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT CASE WHEN onboarded_by IS NULL THEN 'self-serve' ELSE 'field agent' END AS route, count(*) AS created,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS verified FROM businesses WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Active and live stores per day
panels.description: Active: verified with a staff app open or POS sale that day. Live: active with ≥ 50 listed items, stock updated in 72 h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, active_stores AS active, live_stores AS live, verified_stores AS verified FROM rollup_daily_platform WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: POS sales per day by link method
panels.description: bill_qr and counter_code are linked sales; phone_unverified only adds the customer to the shop's list (D-07).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(sold_at, '1d'), coalesce(link_method, 'none') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM pos_sales
WHERE status = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(sold_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT p.store_id) AS value FROM v_metric_pos_sales p JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.sold_at) AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')

panels.title: Linked share of POS sales
panels.description: Share of POS sales linked by bill_qr or counter_code.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(p.linked::int) AS value FROM v_metric_pos_sales p JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.sold_at) AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')

panels.title: Stock updates by source and route
panels.description: Movements by D-01 source and by how they came in (device = POS; ref_type for bill scan, voice, import).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source, CASE WHEN device_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'pos' ELSE coalesce(ref_type, 'manual') END AS via, count(*) AS movements
FROM stock_movements WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN accept_rate_30d >= 0.9 THEN '90 %+' WHEN accept_rate_30d >= 0.75 THEN '75–90 %' WHEN accept_rate_30d >= 0.5 THEN '50–75 %' ELSE '< 50 %' END AS bucket,
       count(*) AS stores, min(accept_rate_30d) AS o
FROM stores s WHERE s.accept_rate_30d IS NOT NULL AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY o DESC

panels.title: Stores above the expiry penalty threshold

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS store, s.id AS store_id, round(100 * s.unaccepted_expiry_rate_30d, 1) AS expiry_pct
FROM stores s, platform_settings ps
WHERE ps.key = 'shop_expiry_penalty_threshold_bp' AND s.unaccepted_expiry_rate_30d * 10000 > (ps.value #>> '{}')::numeric AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')
ORDER BY s.unaccepted_expiry_rate_30d DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Store strikes in 30 days
panels.description: Strikes per store; at_threshold when it reaches store_strike_risk_threshold (D-67).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS store, s.id AS store_id, count(*) AS strikes,
       count(*) >= max((ps.value #>> '{}')::int) AS at_threshold
FROM strikes k JOIN stores s ON s.id = k.subject_id, platform_settings ps
WHERE k.subject_type = 'store' AND k.reset_at IS NULL AND k.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND ps.key = 'store_strike_risk_threshold' AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')
GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY strikes DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT round(s.rating_avg)::int::text || '★' AS rating, count(*) AS stores FROM stores s WHERE s.rating_count > 0 AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Review reply rate (range)
panels.description: Share of reviews the shop replied to.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((rr.review_id IS NOT NULL AND rr.deleted_at IS NULL)::int) AS value FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN review_replies rr ON rr.review_id = r.id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.accept_seconds) AS value FROM v_metric_orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.accepted AND $__timeFilter(o.placed_at) AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')

panels.title: Banners (banner_daily)
panels.description: Impressions, taps and orders attributed by last tap within 24 h (D-77).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.store_id, s.name AS store, sum(d.impressions) AS impressions, sum(d.clicks) AS clicks, sum(d.attributed_orders) AS attributed_orders
FROM banner_daily d JOIN store_banners b ON b.id = d.banner_id JOIN stores s ON s.id = b.store_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.date) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Offers created and redeemed
panels.description: Offers by kind. Uplift (orders on offer items vs before) needs per-item order history per offer window (TODO(lead): add when W3-03 lands its offer insight).

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind, count(*) AS offers, sum(redemptions) AS redemptions FROM offers WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT (s.cashback_bp / 100)::text || ' %' AS cashback, count(*) AS stores FROM stores s WHERE s.status = 'live' AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}') GROUP BY s.cashback_bp ORDER BY s.cashback_bp

options.content: Demand insights viewed / actions / "Not useful" per kind (D-99) and voice update confirmation rate come from `insight_*` and `ai_draft_*` events, which are not catalogued yet (W3-03, W3-10). **TODO(lead).**

panels.title: Stores (7 d)
panels.description: Sortable. needs_attention: more than half the stock stale, unaccepted-expiry rate above 20 % (TODO(lead): confirm these two lines; they are not in 01), or no activity in 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(orders) AS orders, sum(completed) AS completed, avg(avg_accept_seconds) AS avg_accept_s, sum(pos_sales) AS pos_sales
           FROM rollup_daily_store WHERE date > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 7 GROUP BY store_id),
t AS (SELECT store_id, items_listed, items_fresh_24h, items_stale FROM rollup_daily_store WHERE date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date),
a AS (SELECT store_id, max(at) AS last_active FROM v_metric_store_activity WHERE at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT s.name AS store, s.id AS store_id, s.city, coalesce(c.names->>'en', '') AS category,
       coalesce(r.orders, 0) AS orders_7d, round(100.0 * r.completed / nullif(r.orders, 0)) AS success_pct, round(r.avg_accept_s) AS avg_accept_s,
       round(100.0 * t.items_fresh_24h / nullif(t.items_listed, 0)) AS fresh_24h_pct, s.rating_avg AS rating, coalesce(r.pos_sales, 0) AS pos_sales_7d,
       a.last_active,
       (coalesce(t.items_stale::float / nullif(t.items_listed, 0), 0) > 0.5 OR coalesce(s.unaccepted_expiry_rate_30d, 0) > 0.2
        OR a.last_active IS NULL OR a.last_active < now() - interval '7 days') AS needs_attention
FROM stores s JOIN businesses b ON b.id = s.business_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t ON t.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id = s.id
WHERE b.status = 'verified' AND ('${city}' = '__all' OR s.city = '${city}')
ORDER BY needs_attention DESC, orders_7d DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Field agents: shops per agent per week
panels.description: Businesses an agent created, by IST week. The agent is shown by user id (no names on dashboards).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', b.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS week, b.onboarded_by AS agent_user_id, count(*) AS onboarded,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS verified,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stores s WHERE s.business_id = b.id AND s.status = 'live')) AS live
FROM businesses b WHERE b.onboarded_by IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(b.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC, 3 DESC
